target_customer: Collectors and hobbyists buying and selling toys, comics and Funko Pop
problem: Collectors lacked a curated place to catalog, price, trade and sell collectibles; eBay was haphazard.
business_model: Marketplace take rate plus collection management tools

founders.name: Reid Nahm
prior_employers: A lost and found recovery service
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2017-08 says he collected Spider-Man comics.

founders.name: Evan Beland
founders.background_notes: Named among the founders in TechCrunch 2017-08; not on the YC page.

competitors.name: eBay
competitors.what: General online marketplace used by collectors
competitors.traction_then: Dominant general marketplace; TechCrunch called its organization haphazard

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile and web marketplace with pricing and inventory tools; standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Collector inventory data could create some lock-in but eBay and others could copy curation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows eBay reacting; Covetly is listed Inactive with no public cause.

market_need_then: TechCrunch 2017-08 reported collectors uploaded over 20 million dollars of items in 2017 alone and the founders said sellers and buyers needed pricing and curation help.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful: the tagline asks what do you covet.

brand_strength.rationale: One TechCrunch article and a Product Hunt post; no merch or community evidence found.

pivots.from: App for trading items, described as Tinder for stuff
pivots.to: Collectibles marketplace with pricing and curation
pivots.why: Founders wanted to help collectors through the whole collection process

outcome_analysis: Covetly began in 2015 as a swap app and moved to a curated collectibles marketplace by its Summer 2017 batch, raising a reported 120 thousand dollars. It is now marked Inactive by YC and dead by CB Insights, but no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: The seed round rests on a single database (CB Insights, 120K, 2017-08-23); Crunchbase labels it pre-seed, and this was seen only in search snippets. The website covetly.com did not resolve. Founded year 2014 is from the YC page; TechCrunch says 2015 for the app. Name origin not stated by sources.
